page.overview:
Who is Gerudo Captain?

Gerudo Captains appear in The Champion Urbosa, where they are initially tricked into helping Master Kohga, then ally with Zelda. They also appear in Down with the Yiga Clan, where they have infiltrated the hideout with varying degrees of success. As well, they appear in Air and Lightning, All Hyrule United and The Final Battle. They, like Hylian Captains, can use all weapons that Link uses.

Category:Female characters Category:Enemies in Hyrule Warriors: Age of Imprisonment
